sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The illustrations show how chocolate is produced. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people say that all students should study history as a major subject, while others feels that other subjects are important for children in today's society. Discuss both sides and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
